caption: The drawing features a central figure standing inside a rectangular frame. The figure is dressed in a long, reddish-brown robe and is depicted with one arm bent across the chest and the other arm raised, holding a small round object with dark protrusions, possibly a fruit or religious symbol. The face of the figure is lightly sketched with closed eyes and short, dark hair. The background within the frame is a muted beige or light tan, with darker stains or shading giving it a worn appearance. The inner edges of the frame are bordered by a wavy, ribbon-like design in shades of brown, and the outer edges of the frame are darker, nearly black. The sheet of paper on which the drawing is placed is a pale, light tan or cream color, and there is handwritten text below the image, some in red and some in brown or gray. The composition centers on the single figure with minimal extraneous detail around it, emphasizing the contrast between the reddish garment and the paler background.
title: Santo
